description: Add CredentialDaemonCredentialsProvider, which resolves credentials from a local credential daemon over a Unix domain socket for profiles that set daemon_credential in the shared config file. Compatibility note: the provider requires Linux or macOS. On Java 8 to 15 it also requires the optional junixsocket library (com.kohlschutter.junixsocket:junixsocket-core) on the class path, and fails with UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM without it.
